subject: Final verdict & DayZero orchestration: MAP, eval close, approvals
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <s.patel@novusretail.com>, Monica Ramos <monica.ramos@novusretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + eval wrap: proposed approval gates and day-zero plan

Hi Samir / Monica —

Thanks again for a productive week of evaluations. As discussed on the call, attached is our draft mutual action plan (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) and a short evaluation-result summary. This email maps the remaining approval gates and gives a proposed DayZero (startdate) orchestration so legal and ops can align on sign timing.

High-level ask: please confirm whether Novus can:
- Approve the MAP milestones as-is OR propose a single redline by EOD Thu (2026-08-06).
- Confirm the signer window (Monica — legal) for countersignature between Aug 10–12.
- Commit to DayZero start date of Aug 17 if countersignature completes by Aug 12.

Key files attached: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones & acceptance criteria), Evaluation_Result_Summary.xlsx (short pass/fail + perf notes), SLA_addendum_draft.docx (ops-level SLA with latency targets).

Proposed approval cadence (we recommend):
1) Commercial sign-off (Samir) — confirm budget approval and PO intent by Thu 2026-08-06.
2) Legal review (Monica) — one consolidated redline; target countersign window Aug 10–12.
3) Ops readiness check (Redwood) — final environment prep Aug 13–14.
4) DayZero launch — Aug 17 (soft launch, limited traffic for first 72h).

If you prefer a different start date, tell us the latest acceptable countersign date and we will shift the ops window. I’ll follow up internally with Ben and Laura to coordinate the DocuSign pack and the handoff runbook.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (map), Evaluation_Result_Summary.xlsx, SLA_addendum_draft.docx

- Ops question: we have a blackout on heavy deployments the week of Aug 16 due to merchandising peak prep. If countersign slips past Aug 12, our preferred DayZero would be Aug 24.

Samir

s.patel@novusretail.com | +1 (213) 555-6621

I can aim to produce a single consolidated redline by Thu Aug 6 EOD but two asks from legal:
1) Please confirm the data residency sentence we discussed in the SLA_addendum_draft.docx (we need a one-line clause specifying EU-only processing for PII if Novus chooses EU region).
2) Can Redwood provide a marked-up version of the MAP that ties each acceptance criterion to an evaluation artifact (e.g., unit test name / eval set id) so legal can reference it in the contract?

If those two items are addressed this afternoon, I should be able to turn around the redline. If not, we should schedule a 30-min legal sync Fri morning to finish.

Monica Ramos

monica.ramos@novusretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0144

- Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf — now includes a short mapping column ("Eval artifact") linking each acceptance criteria to the corresponding eval set ID.
- SLA_addendum_draft.docx — added a one-line EU-processing residency clause that's optional and region-gated.

DocuSign & timeline:
- Ben will assemble the DocuSign packet tonight (MAP + commercial addendum + SLA addendum as separate documents).
- Requested DocuSign send date: Mon Aug 9 (so countersign can occur Aug 10–12 per Monica's window).
- If countersign completes by Aug 12, ops will run the final environment prep Aug 13–14 and we will target DayZero Aug 17 (soft launch).
- If countersign slips, Novus indicated Aug 24 is the alternate DayZero.

Action items:
- Monica: please confirm the redline acceptance on the attached PDFs by Mon Aug 9 10:00 AM PT so Ben can send DocuSign that afternoon.
- Samir: confirm PO intent note (short email ok) by Thu Aug 6 EOD — that will clear commercial.
- Ben / Laura (Redwood): prepare DocuSign bundle and an ops runbook for Aug 13–14.

We attached: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (marked), SLA_addendum_draft.docx (marked), Evaluation_Result_Summary.xlsx.

If everyone confirms the timeline, I’ll mark the deal in HubSpot as "Ready for Signature" and set up the DayZero runbook in our onboarding tracker.

Thanks all —
